description: NeXT TIFF v4.0 pasteboard type from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened /private/tmp/rclip-capture/bands.png (24x16 truecolour PNG, three vertical colour bands, written by hand with zlib), then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: Byte-identical to the modern UTI's data: AppKit publishes the legacy NSPasteboardType name and the UTI as two names for one representation.
